kind: reverify-K-gated hand mutants (the re-verifier's own, distinct from the fixers' FG-m-*): each weakens a D1/D2/D4/D5/D6 protection

mutants.describes: http_get builds its opener with urllib's stock HTTPRedirectHandler (keeps Authorization across every redirect)
the handler drops Authorization on a same-origin redirect and keeps it off-origin
mutants.find: if new is not None and not same_origin(req.full_url, newurl):
mutants.replace: if new is not None and same_origin(req.full_url, newurl):

mutants.describes: http_get opens without a timeout (a hang instead of a refusal)
http_get catches URLError only: a bare TimeoutError, SSLError, ConnectionResetError or IncompleteRead propagates as a traceback
http_get catches OSError only: http.client.IncompleteRead propagates
the whoami NO_REPLY branch is dropped: status 0 falls through to 'the token is not valid'
mutants.find: if status == NO_REPLY:                 # D4: the network or TLS failed before any answer; a refusal, not a traceback

mutants.describes: failure_text drops the exact-value replace and keeps the pattern sub only (a token not of the hf_ shape would stay in the line)
failure_text drops the pattern sub and keeps the exact-value replace only (a second token in the reason would stay)
a Range request with no reply is skipped silently instead of refusing (nine 206s pass)
